description: Angular component for branch autocomplete functionality in the Thingsboard UI, including form control, branch fetching, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: BranchAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a branch selection autocomplete with form control, fetching branch data, and user interaction logic.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filteredBranches observable with branch filtering logic based on user input.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the component.

methods.name: isDefaultBranchSelected
methods.description: Checks if the default branch is currently selected.

methods.name: selectDefaultBranchIfNeeded
methods.description: Selects the default branch if conditions are met.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a new value to the component and updates the form control.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updating validity if needed.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, possibly selecting available value.

methods.name: selectAvailableValue
methods.description: Selects the closest matching branch when user input is finalized.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: displayBranchFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a branch.

methods.name: fetchBranches
methods.description: Fetches branch list filtered by search text.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Retrieves branch list from service and sets default branch.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the current selection and resets input focus.
